description: Source code for AffineQuantizerBase.cpp, implementing quantization utilities and functions for quantized tensors in PyTorch, including FBGEMM support and ARM NEON optimizations.

methods.name: checkZeroPoint
methods.description: Checks if zero_point is within the valid range for type T.

methods.name: quantize_val
methods.description: Quantizes a float value to type T using scale and zero_point, with support for FBGEMM and ARM NEON.

methods.name: quantize_vec
methods.description: Quantizes a vector of float values to type T using scale and zero_point.

methods.name: dequantize_val
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized value of type T back to float.

methods.name: quantize_val_float_qparams
methods.description: Quantizes a float value based on scale and zero_point in float, with clamping to qmin and qmax.

methods.name: requantize_val
methods.description: Requantizes a value from source to destination scale and zero_point.

methods.name: requantize_from_int
methods.description: Requantizes an integer value from one scale/zero_point to another.
